    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">使用 Vibe Coding 构建 AI 自动化评测系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>1.概述</h1>
<p>在当今快速发展的 AI 时代，如何高效、准确地评估 AI 模型的性能已成为一个关键挑战。传统的评测方法往往依赖大量人工干预，不仅效率低下，而且难以保证评测的一致性和客观性。本文将深入探讨如何使用 Vibe Coding 的理念，结合现代 AI 技术，构建一个智能、高效且可扩展的自动化评测系统。我们将从系统架构设计出发，详细剖析核心组件的实现，并分享在实际项目中积累的最佳实践。</p>
<h1>2.内容</h1>
<h2>2.1&nbsp;什么是 Vibe Coding？</h2>
<p>Vibe Coding 是一种新兴的开发理念，它强调通过直觉、流程和氛围来驱动代码编写，而非传统的、严格的规划。它鼓励开发者：<br>以流程为中心：将复杂的系统分解为一系列清晰的、可执行的流程。<br>快速原型：通过快速迭代和原型验证来探索最佳解决方案。<br>氛围驱动：在轻松、创造性的环境中进行开发，鼓励实验和创新。<br>在构建我们的 AI 自动化评测系统时，我们将遵循 Vibe Coding 的原则，将复杂的评测任务分解为一系列独立的、可组合的模块，从而实现系统的灵活性和可扩展性。</p>
<h2>2.2&nbsp;系统架构概览</h2>
<p>我们的自动化评测系统采用经典的分层架构，以确保各组件之间的低耦合和高内聚。整个系统可以分为四个主要层次：</p>
<h3>1. 表示层 (Presentation Layer)</h3>
<p>这是系统与用户交互的入口，负责接收评测请求和展示结果。</p>
<ul>
<li>API 网关 (API Gateway)：作为所有外部请求的统一入口，负责路由分发、协议转换、请求限流和熔断。</li>
<li>负载均衡器 (Load Balancer)：将 incoming traffic 分发到多个后端服务实例，确保高可用性和性能。</li>
<li>认证授权服务 (Auth Service)：处理用户身份验证和权限控制，确保系统安全。</li>
<li>前端界面 (Frontend)：提供用户友好的 Web 界面，用于提交评测任务、查看结果和监控系统状态。</li>
</ul>
<h3>2. 业务逻辑层 (Business Logic Layer)</h3>
<p>这是系统的核心，包含了所有与 AI 评测相关的业务逻辑。</p>
<ul>
<li>AI 评测引擎 (AI Evaluation Engine)：这是系统的“大脑”，负责加载和执行 AI 模型，对输入数据进行推理，并计算各项评测指标。</li>
<li>任务调度器 (Task Scheduler)：管理所有待处理的评测任务，根据优先级和资源情况进行调度，并支持任务的并行处理。</li>
<li>结果处理器 (Result Processor)：接收来自 AI 引擎的原始评测结果，进行聚合、格式化和持久化。</li>
<li>缓存管理器 (Cache Manager)：实现多级缓存策略（如内存缓存、Redis 缓存），以加速对频繁请求或计算成本高的数据的访问。</li>
</ul>
<h3>3. 数据访问层 (Data Access Layer)</h3>
<p>该层负责与各种数据存储系统进行交互，为业务逻辑层提供统一的数据访问接口。</p>
<ul>
<li>关系型数据库 (PostgreSQL)：用于存储结构化的元数据，如用户信息、任务配置、模型版本等。</li>
<li>文档数据库 (MongoDB)：用于存储非结构化的评测结果和日志，便于后续的查询和分析。</li>
<li>缓存数据库 (Redis)：作为高速缓存层，存储热点数据和会话信息，以降低后端数据库的压力。</li>
<li>消息队列 (RabbitMQ/Kafka)：作为异步通信的中间件，解耦任务的生产者和消费者，提高系统的吞吐量和容错性。</li>
</ul>
<h3>4. 基础设施层 (Infrastructure Layer)</h3>
<p>提供系统运行所需的基础环境和工具。</p>
<ul>
<li>容器化 (Docker)：将应用及其依赖打包成标准化的容器，实现“一次构建，到处运行”。</li>
<li>容器编排 (Kubernetes)：自动化容器的部署、扩展和管理，提供服务发现、健康检查和自愈能力。</li>
<li>监控系统 (Prometheus + Grafana)：收集和可视化系统的各项性能指标，如 CPU、内存、网络流量等。</li>
<li>日志系统 (ELK Stack)：集中化地收集、存储和分析应用日志，便于问题排查和审计。</li>
</ul>
<h1>3.核心组件实现详解</h1>
<p>接下来，我们将深入探讨业务逻辑层中几个核心组件的具体实现。</p>
<h2>3.1 AI 评测引擎 (AI Evaluation Engine)</h2>
<p>这是整个系统的灵魂。我们使用 Python 和 PyTorch 框架来构建一个灵活、可扩展的评测引擎。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ai_evaluation_engine.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.nn as nn
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dict, List, Any, Optional
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> abc <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ABC, abstractmethod
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logging
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dataclasses <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dataclass

@dataclass
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationResult:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">评测结果数据类</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    score: float
    metrics: Dict[str, float]
    details: Dict[str, Any]
    model_name: str

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseModel(ABC):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">所有评测模型的基类</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span>(self, model_name: str, device: str = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cuda</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        self.model_name </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model_name
        self.device </span>= torch.device(device <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> torch.cuda.is_available() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        self.logger </span>= logging.getLogger(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{__name__}.{model_name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    @abstractmethod
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_model(self, model_path: str):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">加载模型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    @abstractmethod
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> predict(self, input_data: Any) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Any:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">执行模型推理</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    @abstractmethod
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> evaluate(self, prediction: Any, ground_truth: Any) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationResult:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">根据预测结果和真实标签计算评测指标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIEvaluationEngine:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AI 自动化评测引擎</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self):
        self.models: Dict[str, BaseModel] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
        self.logger </span>= logging.getLogger(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> register_model(self, model: BaseModel):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">注册一个评测模型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.models[model.model_name] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model
        self.logger.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Model '{model.model_name}' registered successfully.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> evaluate(self, model_name: str, input_data: List[Any], ground_truths: List[Any]) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> List[EvaluationResult]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用指定模型对一批数据进行评测</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> model_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.models:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> ValueError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Model '{model_name}' not found. Available models: {list(self.models.keys())}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.models[model_name]
        results </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []

        self.logger.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Starting evaluation with model '{model_name}' on {len(input_data)} samples.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, (data, truth) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(zip(input_data, ground_truths)):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                prediction </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.predict(data)
                result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.evaluate(prediction, truth)
                results.append(result)
                self.logger.debug(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sample {i+1}/{len(input_data)} evaluated. Score: {result.score:.4f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error evaluating sample {i+1}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可以选择跳过错误样本或返回一个错误标记的结果</span>
                results.append(EvaluationResult(score=0.0, metrics={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: 1.0}, details={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error_msg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: str(e)}, model_name=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_name))

        self.logger.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Evaluation completed. Average Score: {sum(r.score for r in results) / len(results):.4f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 示例：实现一个具体的文本分类评测模型 ---</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> transformers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> sklearn.metrics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy_score, precision_recall_fscore_support

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TextClassificationModel(BaseModel):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文本分类评测模型示例</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, model_name: str, model_path: str):
        super().</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(model_name)
        self.tokenizer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
        self.model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
        self.model_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model_path
        self.load_model(model_path)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_model(self, model_path: str):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">加载预训练模型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            self.tokenizer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)
            self.model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(model_path)
            self.model.to(self.device)
            self.model.eval()
            self.logger.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Model loaded from {model_path} and moved to {self.device}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to load model: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> predict(self, input_text: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> int:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">对单条文本进行分类预测</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        inputs </span>= self.tokenizer(input_text, return_tensors=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=512<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        inputs </span>= {k: v.to(self.device) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> k, v <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inputs.items()}

        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs </span>= self.model(**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">inputs)
            logits </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> outputs.logits
            predicted_class_id </span>= logits.argmax(-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).item()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> predicted_class_id

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> evaluate(self, prediction: int, ground_truth: int) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationResult:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算分类任务的评测指标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里为了演示，我们假设只处理单个样本的评测</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在实际应用中，通常会批量计算指标以提高效率</span>
        y_true =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [ground_truth]
        y_pred </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [prediction]

        accuracy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
        precision, recall, f1, _ </span>= precision_recall_fscore_support(y_true, y_pred, average=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weighted</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, zero_division=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0)

        metrics </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">accuracy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: accuracy,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">precision</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: precision,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">recall</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: recall,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f1_score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: f1
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationResult(
            score</span>=accuracy, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可以使用F1-score或其他指标作为总体分数</span>
            metrics=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metrics,
            details</span>={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">predicted_class</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: prediction, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true_class</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: ground_truth},
            model_name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">self.model_name
        )

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 使用示例 ---</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    logging.basicConfig(level</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">logging.INFO)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 创建评测引擎</span>
    engine =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIEvaluationEngine()
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 创建并注册一个文本分类模型</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：请替换为你本地的模型路径或HuggingFace模型名</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> text_model = TextClassificationModel("BERT-Classifier", "bert-base-chinese")</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> engine.register_model(text_model)</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 准备评测数据 (示例)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> sample_texts = ["这部电影太棒了！", "这个产品质量很差。"]</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> sample_labels = [1, 0] # 假设 1 代表正面, 0 代表负面</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 执行评测</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> results = engine.evaluate("BERT-Classifier", sample_texts, sample_labels)</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 打印结果</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> for i, result in enumerate(results):</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     print(f"Result {i+1}: Score={result.score:.4f}, Metrics={result.metrics}")</span></pre>
</div>
<h2>3.2 任务调度器 (Task Scheduler)</h2>
<p>为了处理大量的并发评测请求，我们设计了一个基于消息队列的异步任务调度系统。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> task_scheduler.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> asyncio
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dict, Any, Callable
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dataclasses <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dataclass, asdict
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> aioredis
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> celery <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Celery
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logging

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 使用 Celery 作为任务队列的示例 ---</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 假设 Redis 运行在本地</span>
celery_app = Celery(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai_evaluation_tasks</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, broker=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">redis://localhost:6379/0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, backend=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">redis://localhost:6379/0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

@dataclass
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationTask:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">评测任务的数据结构</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    task_id: str
    model_name: str
    input_data: Any
    ground_truth: Any
    callback_url: Optional[str] </span>= None <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于异步通知结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@celery_app.task(bind</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run_evaluation(self, task_data: Dict[str, Any]):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Celery 任务：执行评测</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    task </span>= EvaluationTask(**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">task_data)
    logging.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Task {task.task_id} received. Model: {task.model_name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 这里调用我们之前定义的 AIEvaluationEngine ---</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在实际部署中，engine 实例可以是一个全局单例或通过依赖注入获取</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> result = engine.evaluate(task.model_name, [task.input_data], [task.ground_truth])[0]</span>
        
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟评测过程</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> time; time.sleep(2) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟耗时操作</span>
        result = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.95, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">metrics</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">accuracy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.95}, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: task.model_name} <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        
        logging.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Task {task.task_id} completed successfully.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将结果序列化后返回</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        logging.error(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Task {task.task_id} failed: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 任务失败时，可以选择重试 (Celery 支持自动重试)</span>
        self.retry(countdown=60, max_retries=3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或者返回错误信息</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> return {"error": str(e)}</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TaskScheduler:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">任务调度器</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, engine: AIEvaluationEngine):
        self.engine </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> engine
        self.logger </span>= logging.getLogger(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> submit_task(self, task: EvaluationTask) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提交一个评测任务到队列</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 Celery 的 delay 方法异步执行任务</span>
            job =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run_evaluation.delay(asdict(task))
            self.logger.info(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Task {task.task_id} submitted. Celery Job ID: {job.id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> job.id <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回 Celery 的任务 ID，可用于查询状态</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to submit task {task.task_id}: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> get_task_status(self, celery_task_id: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询任务状态</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        job </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run_evaluation.AsyncResult(celery_task_id)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> job.status <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILURE, RETRY</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> get_task_result(self, celery_task_id: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Any:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">获取任务结果</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        job </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run_evaluation.AsyncResult(celery_task_id)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> job.status == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SUCCESS</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> job.result
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> job.status == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FAILURE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: str(job.result)} <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> job.result 在失败时保存的是异常信息</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: job.status}</pre>
</div>
<h2>3.3 评测指标计算 (Evaluation Metrics)</h2>
<p>一个好的评测系统需要多维度的指标来衡量 AI 模型的性能。我们设计了一个可扩展的指标计算模块。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> evaluation_metrics.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> sklearn.metrics <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy_score, precision_recall_fscore_support, confusion_matrix
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dict, List, Tuple
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dataclasses <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dataclass

@dataclass
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MetricResult:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">单个指标的结果</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    name: str
    value: float
    description: str

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MetricsCalculator:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">评测指标计算器</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">pass</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> calculate_classification_metrics(self, y_true: List[int], y_pred: List[int], average: str = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weighted</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dict[str, MetricResult]:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算分类任务的常用指标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        y_true_np </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.array(y_true)
        y_pred_np </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.array(y_pred)
        
        metrics </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. Accuracy</span>
        accuracy =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy_score(y_true_np, y_pred_np)
        metrics[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">accuracy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = MetricResult(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Accuracy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, value=accuracy, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">准确率：正确预测的比例</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. Precision, Recall, F1-Score</span>
        precision, recall, f1, _ = precision_recall_fscore_support(y_true_np, y_pred_np, average=average, zero_division=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0)
        metrics[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">precision</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = MetricResult(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Precision</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, value=precision, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">精确率：预测为正类中实际为正类的比例</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        metrics[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">recall</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = MetricResult(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Recall</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, value=recall, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">召回率：实际正类中被正确预测的比例</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        metrics[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f1_score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = MetricResult(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">F1-Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, value=f1, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">F1分数：精确率和召回率的调和平均</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. Confusion Matrix</span>
        cm =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> confusion_matrix(y_true_np, y_pred_np)
        metrics[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confusion_matrix</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = MetricResult(name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Confusion Matrix</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, value=cm, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">混淆矩阵：展示分类器性能的可视化工具</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metrics

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> calculate_custom_metric(self, y_true: List[float], y_pred: List[float], metric_func: callable, metric_name: str, description: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MetricResult:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算自定义指标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_func(y_true, y_pred)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> MetricResult(name=metric_name, value=value, description=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">description)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果计算失败，返回一个错误值</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> MetricResult(name=metric_name, value=float(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nan</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>), description=f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算失败: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 使用示例 ---</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟真实标签和预测结果</span>
    y_true = [0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0, 0]
    y_pred </span>= [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0, 0, 0]

    calculator </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MetricsCalculator()
    metrics </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> calculator.calculate_classification_metrics(y_true, y_pred)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=== 分类任务评测结果 ===</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> name, result <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metrics.items():
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> name != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">confusion_matrix</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 混淆矩阵是数组，不直接打印值</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{result.name}: {result.value:.4f} - {result.description}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{result.name}: \n{result.value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h1>4.系统集成与 API 设计</h1>
<p>为了让整个系统能够协同工作，我们需要设计清晰的 API 接口。这里我们使用 FastAPI 来快速构建高性能的 API 服务。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> api_service.py</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> fastapi <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FastAPI, HTTPException, BackgroundTasks
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pydantic <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseModel
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> List, Any, Optional
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uuid
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> task_scheduler <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TaskScheduler, EvaluationTask
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> ai_evaluation_engine <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIEvaluationEngine, TextClassificationModel

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 初始化核心组件 ---</span>
app = FastAPI(title=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AI 自动化评测系统</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
engine </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIEvaluationEngine()
scheduler </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TaskScheduler(engine)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 注册模型 (在实际应用中，这部分可以通过配置文件或数据库动态管理) ---</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> text_model = TextClassificationModel("BERT-Classifier", "path/to/your/model")</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> engine.register_model(text_model)</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- Pydantic 模型，用于请求和响应的验证 ---</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_name: str
    input_data: List[Any] </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据模型类型，这里可以是文本、图像路径等</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ground_truth: List[Any]

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluateResponse(BaseModel):
    task_id: str
    message: str

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TaskStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    task_id: str
    status: str
    result: Optional[Any] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- API 路由 ---</span>
@app.post(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/evaluate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, response_model=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EvaluateResponse)
async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> submit_evaluation_task(request: EvaluateRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提交一个异步评测任务</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    task_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str(uuid.uuid4())
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里简化处理，只提交第一个样本进行评测</span>
    task =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EvaluationTask(
        task_id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">task_id,
        model_name</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">request.model_name,
        input_data</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">request.input_data[0],
        ground_truth</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">request.ground_truth[0]
    )
    
    celery_task_id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scheduler.submit_task(task)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> EvaluateResponse(task_id=celery_task_id, message=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Task submitted successfully.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

@app.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/task/{task_id}/status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, response_model=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TaskStatusResponse)
async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_task_status(task_id: str):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">查询任务状态和结果</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    status </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scheduler.get_task_status(task_id)
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> status == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SUCCESS</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scheduler.get_task_result(task_id)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> TaskStatusResponse(task_id=task_id, status=status, result=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">result)

@app.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/models</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list_available_models():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">列出当前可用的评测模型</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">available_models</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: list(engine.models.keys())}

@app.get(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/health</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> health_check():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">系统健康检查接口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">healthy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">engine_models_count</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: len(engine.models)}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> --- 运行应用 ---</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 命令行运行: `uvicorn api_service:app --reload`</span></pre>
</div>

<div class="cnblogs_code">

version: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">3.8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<h1>&nbsp;7.总结</h1>
<p>通过 Vibe Coding 的方式，我们成功地构建了一个模块化、可扩展的 AI 自动化评测系统。这个系统不仅能够自动化地执行模型评测任务，还提供了丰富的 API 接口和灵活的部署方案。<br>未来，我们计划从以下几个方面进行优化和扩展：</p>
<ul>
<li>支持更多模型和任务类型：目前系统以文本分类为例，未来可以扩展到图像识别、语音识别、生成式 AI 等多种任务。</li>
<li>引入更丰富的评测指标：除了准确率、F1 分数等基础指标，还可以引入鲁棒性、公平性、可解释性等更高级的评测维度。</li>
<li>构建可视化报表系统：开发一个强大的前端界面，将评测结果以图表、仪表盘等形式直观地展示出来。</li>
<li>集成 MLOps 流程：将评测系统与模型训练、部署、监控等 MLOps 流程深度集成，形成一个完整的 AI 应用生命周期管理平台。</li>
</ul>
<p>希望本文能为您在构建自己的 AI 评测系统时提供一些思路和参考。Happy Coding!</p>
<p>最后，提供一键生成 Prompt 描述：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_4a4ac98b-13ef-4622-8484-5ac29f5fec96" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_4a4ac98b-13ef-4622-8484-5ac29f5fec96" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_4a4ac98b-13ef-4622-8484-5ac29f5fec96" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre>请为我生成一个完整的 AI 自动化评测系统，包含以下所有模块：

【1. 后端架构模块】
- FastAPI 应用主体和路由配置
- Celery 异步任务队列配置
- Redis 连接和缓存管理
- PostgreSQL 数据库模型
- 统一的配置管理
- 错误处理和日志系统

【2. AI 评测引擎模块】
- 可扩展的模型基类定义
- BERT 文本分类模型实现
- GPT 文本生成模型实现
- GPU 加速工具类
- 批处理优化逻辑
- 内存管理和缓存机制

【3. 评测指标模块】
- 分类指标计算器 (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1)
- 回归指标计算器 (MAE, MSE, R²)
- 自定义指标基类
- 指标可视化工具
- 评测报告生成器

【4. 任务调度模块】
- Celery 任务定义和装饰器
- 任务提交和状态管理
- 任务优先级配置
- 任务重试机制
- 并发控制设置

【5. API 接口模块】
- FastAPI 路由和请求验证
- Pydantic 请求/响应模型
- 认证和授权中间件
- 错误响应处理
- OpenAPI 文档

【6. Docker 部署模块】
- 多阶段构建 Dockerfile
- Docker Compose 服务配置
- 环境变量管理
- 卷挂载和端口映射
- 健康检查配置

【7. 监控日志模块】
- Prometheus 指标收集
- Grafana 仪表盘配置
- 结构化日志输出
- 日志聚合和分析
- 告警规则定义

【8. 测试套件模块】
- pytest 测试框架配置
- 单元测试用例
- 集成测试脚本
- 性能基准测试
- 测试数据和 fixtures

【9. 前端界面模块】
- HTML5 响应式布局
- CSS3 样式和动画
- JavaScript 交互逻辑
- ECharts 数据可视化
- API 调用封装

【10. 文档配置模块】
- 项目 README 文档
- API 接口文档
- 部署指南
- 开发规范
- 使用示例

技术要求：
- Python 3.9+, FastAPI, Celery, Redis
- PyTorch, Transformers, scikit-learn
- PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx
- pytest, Prometheus, Grafana
- HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript

输出要求：
1. 创建完整的项目目录结构
2. 生成所有核心代码文件
3. 提供配置文件和脚本
4. 包含部署和运维文件
5. 提供详细的文档说明
6. 给出基础使用示例

项目结构示例：
ai-evaluation-system/
├── backend/
│   ├── api/
│   ├── core/
│   ├── models/
│   ├── tasks/
│   ├── tests/
│   ├── requirements.txt
│   └── Dockerfile
├── frontend/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── static/
│   └── app.js
├── deploy/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml
│   └── kubernetes.yaml
├── docs/
│   └── *.md
└── examples/
    └── basic_usage.py</pre>
</div>

<h1 class="ds-markdown-paragraph">8.结束语</h1>
